	local v48 = table.create(p42 + 1)
	local v49 = 1 / p42
	local v50 = p44 - p43
	local v51 = v50.Magnitude
	if v51 > 0.001 then
		p47 = v50 / v51
	end
	local v52, v53 = v_u_4.getPerpendicularVectors(p47)

	for v55 = 1, p42 - 1 do
		local v56 = p43:Lerp(p44, v55 * v49)

		local v59 = v57 * p46 * v54

local function v_u_75(p64, p65, p66, p67, p68) -- name: getBlendedPosition
	local v69 = (1 - p64) * p68.boltLength
	local v70 = (p68.distanceTraveled - v69) / p68.transitionBuffer

local function v_u_101(p76, p77, p78, p79, p80, p81, p82, p83, p84) -- name: generateTransitionPoints

function v_u_44.prototype._reject(p_u_342, ...) -- name: _reject

function v_u_44.prototype._finalize(p354) -- name: _finalize
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_44
	for _, v355 in ipairs(p354._queuedFinally) do
		coroutine.wrap(v355)(p354._status)
	end

	p354._queuedReject = nil
	p354._queuedResolve = nil

		p354._parent = nil

		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) v_u_44, (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_122, (copy) v_u_45, (copy) v_u_51, (ref) v_u_5

			end

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_58, (ref) v_u_51, (ref) v_u_126

	local function v153(p149) -- name: handleStun
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_51, (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_45, (copy) v_u_55, (copy) v_u_44

		if v_u_58.isTrueStunned then

		elseif v_u_58.isBreaking or v_u_58.isVaulting then

				if v150.shake ~= false then
					v_u_51.shake:Fire(1, 1, v_u_45.CameraOffset)
				end
				if p149 then
					v151:AdjustSpeed(v150.releaseSpeed or 0.5)
				end

					if v_u_58.isTrueStunned and v_u_45.WalkSpeed ~= 0 then

					end
				end)
				if v150.beforeTrackPlay then

				end

					v152:Disconnect()
				end
			end
			if v150.afterTrack then
				v150.afterTrack(v_u_113, p149)
			end
			v_u_51.stunOver:FireServer()
			v_u_113.setAction(false)
			v_u_58.isStunned = false
			v_u_58.attackCount = 0
			v_u_58.canUpdateSpeed = true
			v_u_58.isAttacking = false
			v_u_58.isTrueStunned = false

			v_u_45.AutoRotate = true

			end
		end
	end
	local function v157(p154, ...) -- name: handleAfterAttack
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_44, (copy) v_u_45, (copy) v_u_51, (copy) v_u_55
		local v155 = p_u_42.afterAttack or {}
		if v_u_58.isTrueStunned then
			return
		elseif v155.custom then
			v155.custom(v_u_113, p154, ...)
		else
			v_u_58.isStunned = true
			v_u_58.canUpdateSpeed = false
			v_u_58.isLunging = false
			if v155.beforeStart then
				v155.beforeStart(v_u_113, p154, ...)
			end
			if p154 == "Parried" then
				v_u_44:SetAttribute("Immobile", true)
				v_u_45.WalkSpeed = 0
				if v155.parriedVmTrack then
					v_u_113.playAnimationNoStop(v155.parriedVmTrack, true)
				end
				v_u_51.shake:Fire(3, 0.6, v_u_45.CameraOffset)
			else
				v_u_45.WalkSpeed = (v_u_44:GetAttribute("Speed") or 0) * (v_u_44:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1) * (v155.slowMultiplier or 0.1535)
			end
			if p154 == "Nothing" then
				task.wait(v155.nothingDelay or 1.5)
			else
				v_u_113.stopAllAnimations()
				if v155.beforeTrack then
					p154 = v155.beforeTrack(v_u_113, p154, ...) or p154
				end
				local v156 = v_u_55[p154]
				if v156 then
					v156:Play()
					if v155.onTrackPlay then
						v155.onTrackPlay(v_u_113, p154, v156, ...)
					end
					if p154 == "Parried" then
						task.wait(v155.parriedDuration or 4)
					else
						v156.Stopped:Wait()
					end
				end
			end
			if p154 == "Parried" then
				v_u_44:SetAttribute("Immobile", false)
			end
			v_u_58.isStunned = false
			v_u_58.canUpdateSpeed = true
			v_u_113.setAction(false)
			v_u_58.attackCount = 0
			v_u_58.isAttacking = false
			if not v_u_58.isTrueStunned then
				v_u_45.WalkSpeed = (v_u_44:GetAttribute("Speed") or 0) * (v_u_44:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
			end
			if v155.afterEnd then
				v155.afterEnd(v_u_113, p154, ...)
			end
		end
	end

						local v99 = (p_u_88.APPLY_WHEN_SPRINTING_ONLY and true or false) and p_u_88.APPLY_WHEN_SPRINTING_ONLY
						if v99 then
							v99 = p_u_88.isShiftHeld
						end
						if v97 and v99 then
							local v100 = p_u_88.humanoid.MoveDirection
							if v100.Magnitude > 0 then
								p_u_88.targetYaw = p_u_88:_getYaw((CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v100)))
								if p_u_88.currentYaw == nil then
									p_u_88.currentYaw = p_u_88:_getYaw(p_u_88.humanoidRootPart.CFrame)
								end
								local v101 = p_u_88:_angleDifference(p_u_88.currentYaw, p_u_88.targetYaw)
								local v102 = -p_u_88.TURN_SPEED * p96
								local v103 = 1 - math.exp(v102)
								local v104 = p_u_88.TURN_SMOOTHNESS
								local v105 = v103 * (1 - math.clamp(v104, 0, 0.999))
								local v106 = math.clamp(v105, 0, 1)
								p_u_88.currentYaw = p_u_88.currentYaw + v101 * v106
								p_u_88.humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(p_u_88.humanoidRootPart.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, p_u_88.currentYaw, 0)
							end
						else
							p_u_88.currentYaw = nil
							p_u_88.targetYaw = nil
						end
					end
					if p_u_88.PENALTY_ENABLED and v97 then
						local v107 = p_u_88:_getYaw(p_u_88.humanoidRootPart.CFrame)
						local v108
						if p_u_88.lastYaw then
							local v109 = p_u_88:_shortestAngleDelta(p_u_88.lastYaw, v107)
							local v110 = math.deg(v109)
							local v111 = math.abs(v110)
							v108 = v111 / math.max(p96, 0.004166666666666667)
							local v112 = p_u_88.TURN_DEADZONE_DEG < v110 and 1 or (v110 < -p_u_88.TURN_DEADZONE_DEG and -1 or 0)
							if v112 ~= 0 then
								if p_u_88.rotationDirection == 0 then
									p_u_88.rotationDirection = v112
									p_u_88.accumulatedRotation = 0
								elseif p_u_88.rotationDirection == v112 then
									p_u_88.accumulatedRotation = p_u_88.accumulatedRotation + v111
								else
									p_u_88.rotationDirection = v112
									p_u_88.accumulatedRotation = 0
									p_u_88.turnSlowFactor = 1
								end
							end
							if v108 < p_u_88.DECAY_WHEN_SLOW_DEG_PER_S then
								local v113 = p_u_88
								local v114 = p_u_88.accumulatedRotation - p_u_88.ROTATION_DECAY_RATE * p96
								v113.accumulatedRotation = math.max(0, v114)
								if p_u_88.accumulatedRotation == 0 then
									p_u_88.rotationDirection = 0
								end
							end
						else
							v108 = 0
						end
						p_u_88.lastYaw = v107
						local v115
						if p_u_88.accumulatedRotation > p_u_88.ROTATION_THRESHOLD and p_u_88.TURN_SPEED_THRESHOLD < v108 then
							local v116 = (v108 - p_u_88.TURN_SPEED_THRESHOLD) / (p_u_88.TURN_SPEED_MAX - p_u_88.TURN_SPEED_THRESHOLD)
							v115 = 1 - math.clamp(v116, 0, 1) * (1 - p_u_88.PENALTY_MIN_FACTOR)
						else
							v115 = 1
						end
						if p_u_88.isShiftHeld then
							if v115 < p_u_88.turnSlowFactor then
								local v117 = -p_u_88.PENALTY_APPLY_SPEED * p96
								local v118 = 1 - math.exp(v117)
								p_u_88.turnSlowFactor = p_u_88.turnSlowFactor + (v115 - p_u_88.turnSlowFactor) * v118
							else
								local v119 = p_u_88
								local v120 = p_u_88.turnSlowFactor + v98 * p96
								local v121 = p_u_88.PENALTY_MIN_FACTOR
								v119.turnSlowFactor = math.clamp(v120, v121, 1)
							end
						else
							p_u_88.turnSlowFactor = 1
						end
					elseif p_u_88.PENALTY_ENABLED and not v97 then
						p_u_88.lastYaw = nil
						p_u_88.accumulatedRotation = 0
						p_u_88.rotationDirection = 0
						p_u_88.turnSlowFactor = 1
					end
					p_u_88.currentTurnSlowFactor = p_u_88.turnSlowFactor
					if not (p_u_88.cantupdatespeed or p_u_88.character:GetAttribute("MovementLocked")) then
						p_u_88:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p_u_88:_getDesiredBaseSpeed())
					end
				end
			else
				p_u_88.currentYaw = nil
				return
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_9._getDesiredBaseSpeed(p122) -- name: _getDesiredBaseSpeed
	local v123
	if p122.isEmoting then
		v123 = p122.emoteWalkSpeed
	elseif p122.isCtrlHeld then
		v123 = p122.crouchSpeed
	elseif p122.humanoid.Health <= 50 then
		v123 = p122.knockedWalkSpeed
	elseif p122.isShiftHeld and not p122.character:GetAttribute("Aiming") then
		v123 = p122.runSpeed
	else
		v123 = p122.normalWalkSpeed
	end
	if p122.isEmoting then
		return v123
	else
		return v123 * p122:_getSpeedBoost()
	end
end
function v_u_9._checkConditions(p124) -- name: _checkConditions
	if p124:_movementLocked() then
		return
	else
		local v125 = p124.humanoid.Health
		if p124.isSlowedFromFall then
			local v126 = p124.fallDistance
			local v127 = p124.fallDistance and p124.fallDistance > 20 and 20 or v126
			p124.runSpeed = 17 - v127 / 1.7
			p124.normalWalkSpeed = 10 - v127 / 3
			p124.crouchSpeed = 6 - v127 / 4
			if p124.isCtrlHeld then
				local v128 = p124.crouchSpeed
				p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth((math.max(v128, 2)))
				return
			elseif p124.isShiftHeld then
				local v129 = p124.runSpeed
				p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(math.max(v129, 2) * p124:_getSpeedBoost())
			else
				local v130 = p124.normalWalkSpeed
				p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(math.max(v130, 2) * p124:_getSpeedBoost())
			end
		elseif p124.humanoid.WalkSpeed == 0 then
			return
		elseif v125 <= 50 then
			p124.isKnocked = true
			if p124.platform == "Mobile" then
				p124.isShiftHeld = false
				p124.isCtrlHeld = false
				p124:_syncSprint()
				p124.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
				p124:_refreshMobileButtons()
			end
			if p124.character:GetAttribute("HookedProgress") and p124.character:GetAttribute("HookedProgress") <= 0 then
				p124:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
			else
				p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p124.knockedWalkSpeed)
			end
		elseif p124.isCtrlHeld then
			p124.isKnocked = false
			p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p124.crouchSpeed)
		elseif v125 <= 70 then
			p124.isKnocked = false
			if not (p124.cantupdatespeed or p124.character:GetAttribute("MovementLocked")) then
				if p124.isShiftHeld and not p124.character:GetAttribute("Aiming") then
					p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p124.runSpeed * p124:_getSpeedBoost())
				else
					p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p124.normalWalkSpeed * p124:_getSpeedBoost())
				end
			end
		elseif p124.isShiftHeld and not p124.character:GetAttribute("Aiming") then
			p124.isKnocked = false
			if not (p124.cantupdatespeed or p124.character:GetAttribute("MovementLocked")) then
				p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p124.runSpeed * p124:_getSpeedBoost())
				return
			end
		else
			p124.isKnocked = false
			if not (p124.cantupdatespeed or p124.character:GetAttribute("MovementLocked")) then
				p124:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p124.normalWalkSpeed * p124:_getSpeedBoost())
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_9._stopRepairAnimation(p131, p132) -- name: _stopRepairAnimation
	if p131.currentRepairAnimTrack then
		p131.currentRepairAnimTrack:Stop()
		p131.currentRepairAnimTrack = nil
	end
	if p132 then
		local v133 = task.wait
		local v134 = p132 - 0.5
		v133((math.max(v134, 0)))
		if p131.currentRepairAnimTrack then
			p131.currentRepairAnimTrack:Stop()
			p131.currentRepairAnimTrack = nil
		end
	end
	if p131:_shouldHardLockSpeed() then
		p131:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
		p131.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	else
		p131:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p131.normalWalkSpeed * p131:_getSpeedBoost())
		p131.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		p131.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end
end
function v_u_9._stopEmote(p135) -- name: _stopEmote
	if p135.isEmoting then
		p135.isEmoting = false
		p135.emoteWalkSpeed = 10
		p135.emoteHandler:FireServer("StopEmote")
		p135.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		p135:_checkConditions()
	end
end
function v_u_9._playHitAnimation(p_u_136) -- name: _playHitAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	if p_u_136.isVaulting or p_u_136.isHitAnimating then
		return
	else
		p_u_136.isHitAnimating = true
		p_u_136:_stopAllAnimations()
		if p_u_136.currentRepairAnimTrack then
			p_u_136.currentRepairAnimTrack:Stop()
			p_u_136.currentRepairAnimTrack = nil
		end
		if p_u_136.humanoid.Health <= 50 then
			p_u_136.isKnocked = true
			if p_u_136.character:GetAttribute("HookedProgress") and p_u_136.character:GetAttribute("HookedProgress") <= 0 then
				p_u_136:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
			else
				p_u_136:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p_u_136.knockedWalkSpeed)
			end
		end
		local v137
		if p_u_136.humanoid.Health >= 50 then
			v137 = p_u_136.animations.hit1
		else
			p_u_136.disableCollisionEvent:FireServer()
			local v138 = v_u_6:GetTagged("Killer")[1]
			if v138 and v138:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local v139 = v138.HumanoidRootPart.Position
				v137 = p_u_136.humanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector:Dot((v139 - p_u_136.humanoidRootPart.Position).Unit) > 0 and p_u_136.animations.hitFront or p_u_136.animations.hitBack
			else
				v137 = p_u_136.animations.hit2
			end
		end
		if v137 then
			v137:Play()
			v137.Stopped:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_136
				p_u_136.isHitAnimating = false
				p_u_136.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
				p_u_136:_checkConditions()
			end)
		else
			p_u_136.isHitAnimating = false
		end
	end
end

end
function v_u_9._isFacingStraightEnough(p150, p151, p152, p153) -- name: _isFacingStraightEnough

	return v154 <= p153, v154
end
function v_u_9._finishVaultOrSlideSpeed(p155) -- name: _finishVaultOrSlideSpeed

function v_u_9._onVaultAnimation(p_u_177, p178, p179) -- name: _onVaultAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	if p_u_177.character and (p_u_177.humanoid and (p_u_177.humanoidRootPart and p_u_177.animator)) then
		p_u_177.character:SetAttribute("__VaultFireCount", (p_u_177.character:GetAttribute("__VaultFireCount") or 0) + 1)
		if not p_u_177.humanoidRootPart:HasTag("doing action") then
			p_u_177:_stopAllAnimations()
			p_u_177.isVaulting = true
			local v180 = p178.Parent
			local v181 = v180:FindFirstChild("inviswall")
			local v182 = v180:FindFirstChild("Bottom")
			local v183 = p_u_177.character.HumanoidRootPart
			p_u_177.characterspeed = v183.Velocity.Magnitude
			p_u_177:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
			p_u_177.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
			p_u_177.humanoid.AutoRotate = false
			local v184 = p_u_177:_isFacingStraightEnough(p178, p_u_177.humanoidRootPart, 40)
			local v185 = p178.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, -1)
			local v186 = (v183.Position - v185.Position).Magnitude * 0.05
			local v187 = math.clamp(v186, 0.005, 0.25)
			local v188 = v_u_7:Create(v183, TweenInfo.new(v187, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				["CFrame"] = v185
			})
			p_u_177.character:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", true)
			v188:Play()
			v188.Completed:Wait()
			local v189
			if p179 and (v184 and p_u_177.characterspeed > 15.25) then
				v189 = math.random() < 0.5 and "RunningVaultAnimation" or "RunningVaultAnimation2"
				task.delay(0.1, function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_177
					p_u_177.fastvault:FireServer(p_u_177.player)
				end)
			else
				v189 = "WalkingVaultAnimation"
			end
			local v190 = p_u_177.smartAnimations[v189] or p_u_177:_tryLoadSmartAnimation(v189)
			local v191 = false
			if v190 then
				if v181 then
					v181.CanCollide = false
				end
				if v182 then
					v182.CanCollide = false
				end
				v190:GetMarkerReachedSignal("isvaulting"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_177
					p_u_177.VaultCompleteEventpart1:FireServer()
				end)
				if p179 and (v184 and (p_u_177.characterspeed > 15.25 and p_u_177.character:GetAttribute("Flowstate"))) then
					local v192 = p_u_177.smartAnimations.finessevault or p_u_177:_tryLoadSmartAnimation("finessevault")
					if v192 then
						v192:GetMarkerReachedSignal("isvaulting"):Connect(function()
							-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_177
							p_u_177.VaultCompleteEventpart1:FireServer()
						end)
						v192:Play(0.96)
						v191 = true
					end
				elseif p179 and (v184 and p_u_177.characterspeed > 15.25) then
					v190:Play(1 * p_u_177.character:GetAttribute("vaultspeed"), false)
					task.wait(0.525)
				elseif p179 and (not v184 or p_u_177.characterspeed < 15.25) then
					v190:Play(1.7 * p_u_177.character:GetAttribute("vaultspeed"), false)
					task.wait(0.725)
				else
					v190:Play(1 * p_u_177.character:GetAttribute("vaultspeed"))
				end
			end
			p_u_177.isVaulting = false
			p_u_177.character:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", false)
			p_u_177.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
			p_u_177.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
			p_u_177:_finishVaultOrSlideSpeed()
			if v181 then
				v181.CanCollide = true
			end
			if v182 then
				v182.CanCollide = true
			end
			p_u_177:_checkConditions()
			task.wait(0.1)
			p_u_177.VaultCompleteEvent:FireServer(p178, v191)
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_9._onPalletDrop(p193, p194, p195) -- name: _onPalletDrop
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	if not p193.humanoidRootPart:HasTag("doing action") then
		p193:_stopAllAnimations()
		p193.isDroppingPallet = true
		p193:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
		p193.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		p193.humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		if p193.platform == "Console" then
			p193:_tempCameraStiffness(5, 1)
		end
		local v196 = {
			["CFrame"] = p194 * CFrame.new(0.05, 1.4, 0.4)
		}
		local v197 = v_u_7:Create(p193.character.HumanoidRootPart, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), v196)
		p193.character:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", true)
		v197:Play()
		v197.Completed:Wait()
		local v198 = math.random() < 0.5 and "PalletDropAnimation" or "PalletDropAnimation2"
		local v199 = p195 == true and (math.random() < 0.5 and "PalletDropAnimationReversed2" or "PalletDropAnimationReversed") or v198
		local v200 = p193.animations[v199]
		if v200 then
			v200:Play()
			v200.Stopped:Wait()
		else
			warn("Failed to create pallet drop animation track.")
		end
		p193:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p193.normalWalkSpeed * p193:_getSpeedBoost())
		p193.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		p193.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		p193.isDroppingPallet = false
		p193.character:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", false)
		if p193.motherscript then
			p193.motherscript:SetAttribute("isDroppingPallet", false)
		end
		p193:_checkConditions()
	end
end
function v_u_9._onPalletSlide(p201, p202, p203) -- name: _onPalletSlide
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	if not p201.humanoidRootPart:HasTag("doing action") then
		p201:_stopAllAnimations()
		local v204 = p202.Parent.PrimaryPart
		local v205 = p202:FindFirstChild("Reversed") and true or false
		if v204 then
			v204 = v204:FindFirstChild("inviswall")
		end
		p201.isSlideingPallet = true
		p201.character:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", true)
		p201.characterspeed = p201.character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude
		p201:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
		p201.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		p201.humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		local v206 = v_u_7:Create(p201.character.HumanoidRootPart, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			["CFrame"] = p202.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.05, 1.4, 0.4)
		})
		v206:Play()
		v206.Completed:Wait()
		local v207 = v205 and (p203 and "RunningSlideAnimationReversed2" or "RunningSlideWalkAnimationRe2") or (p203 and "RunningSlideAnimation2" or "RunningSlideWalkAnimation2")
		local v208 = p201.smartAnimations[v207] or p201:_tryLoadSmartAnimation(v207)
		if v208 then
			if v204 then
				v204.CanCollide = false
			end
			if p203 then
				v208:Play(1 * p201.character:GetAttribute("vaultspeed"), false)
				task.wait(0.7)
			else
				v208:Play(1 * p201.character:GetAttribute("vaultspeed"))
			end
		end
		p201:_finishVaultOrSlideSpeed()
		p201.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		p201.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		if v204 then
			v204.CanCollide = true
		end
		p201.isSlideingPallet = false
		p201.character:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", false)
		if p201.motherscript then
			p201.motherscript:SetAttribute("isSliding", false)
		end
		p201:_checkConditions()
		p201.slideCompleteEvent:FireServer(p202)
	end
end
function v_u_9._onRepairAnim(p_u_209, _, _, p210, p211, p212, p213) -- name: _onRepairAnim
	if not p212 then
		p_u_209:_stopAllAnimations()
		p_u_209:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
		p_u_209.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		p_u_209.humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	end
	if p212 then
		p_u_209:_stopRepairAnimation(p213)
	else
		local v214 = p210 and p210.Name or nil
		p_u_209.currentRepairAnimTrack = p_u_209.animations[v214]
		if not p_u_209.currentRepairAnimTrack then
			local v215 = Instance.new("Animation")
			v215.AnimationId = p211
			p_u_209.currentRepairAnimTrack = p_u_209.humanoid:LoadAnimation(v215)
		end
		if p_u_209.currentRepairAnimTrack then
			p_u_209.currentRepairAnimTrack:Play(0.4)
			p_u_209.currentRepairAnimTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("spark"):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_209
				p_u_209.RepairVFX:FireServer()
			end)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_9._onLeverAnim(p216, p217, _) -- name: _onLeverAnim
	p216:_stopAllAnimations()
	if p217 then
		p216:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
		p216.humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		p216.character:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", true)
		if p216.humanoid.Health > 60 then
			p216.currentRepairAnimTrack = p216.animations.leveropen
		else
			p216.currentRepairAnimTrack = p216.animations.leveropeninjured
		end
		if p216.currentRepairAnimTrack then
			p216.currentRepairAnimTrack:Play(0.4)
		else
			warn("Failed to play lever animation track.")
		end
	else
		p216.character:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", false)
		p216:_stopRepairAnimation()
		p216:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p216.normalWalkSpeed * p216:_getSpeedBoost())
		p216.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		return
	end
end
function v_u_9._onSkillCheckFail(p_u_218, p219, p220) -- name: _onSkillCheckFail
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6
	local v221 = v_u_5.Remotes.Generator:WaitForChild("RepairEvent")
	p_u_218:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
	p_u_218.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	p_u_218.humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	p_u_218:_stopRepairAnimation()
	local v222 = p_u_218.animations.skillCheckFail
	if not v222 then
		local v223 = Instance.new("Animation")
		v223.AnimationId = p219
		v222 = p_u_218.humanoid:LoadAnimation(v223)
	end
	if v222 then
		if p220 then
			v221:FireServer(p220, false, 1.5)
		end
		p_u_218._skillCheckFailToken = (p_u_218._skillCheckFailToken or 0) + 1
		local v_u_224 = p_u_218._skillCheckFailToken
		p_u_218.cantupdatespeed = true
		p_u_218:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
		v222:Play()
		if p_u_218.motherscript then
			p_u_218.motherscript:SetAttribute("isRepairing", false)
		end
		if p_u_218.humanoidRootPart then
			v_u_6:AddTag(p_u_218.humanoidRootPart, "doing action")
		end
		task.delay(1, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_224, (copy) p_u_218, (ref) v_u_6
			if v_u_224 == p_u_218._skillCheckFailToken then
				if p_u_218.humanoidRootPart and p_u_218.humanoidRootPart.Parent then
					v_u_6:RemoveTag(p_u_218.humanoidRootPart, "doing action")
				end
			end
		end)
		task.delay(0.75, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_224, (copy) p_u_218
			if v_u_224 == p_u_218._skillCheckFailToken then
				p_u_218.cantupdatespeed = false
				p_u_218:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p_u_218.normalWalkSpeed * p_u_218:_getSpeedBoost())
				p_u_218.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
				p_u_218.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_9._bindFallDetection(p_u_225) -- name: _bindFallDetection
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v_u_226 = p_u_225.humanoidRootPart.Position.Y
	local v_u_227 = nil
	v_u_4.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_225, (ref) v_u_226, (ref) v_u_227
		if p_u_225.character and p_u_225.character.Parent then
			if p_u_225.humanoid and (p_u_225.humanoidRootPart and p_u_225.humanoidRootPart.Parent) then
				if p_u_225.isVaulting or (p_u_225.isSlideingPallet or (p_u_225.isDroppingPallet or (p_u_225.character:GetAttribute("IsCarried") or p_u_225.character:GetAttribute("IsHooked")))) then
					if p_u_225.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
						v_u_226 = p_u_225.humanoidRootPart.Position.Y
					end
					v_u_227 = nil
					return
				else
					local v228 = p_u_225.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
					local v229 = p_u_225.humanoidRootPart.Position.Y
					if v228 then
						if v_u_227 then
							p_u_225.fallDistance = v_u_227 - v229
							if p_u_225.fallDistance >= 4 then
								p_u_225.fall:FireServer(p_u_225.fallDistance)
							end
							v_u_227 = nil
						end
						v_u_226 = v229
						return
					elseif v_u_227 then
						if v_u_227 < v229 then
							v_u_227 = v229
						end
					else
						v_u_227 = v_u_226
					end
				end
			else
				return
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_9._bindHealingStatus(p_u_230) -- name: _bindHealingStatus
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v_u_231 = nil
	p_u_230.healingMovementConnection = v_u_4.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_230, (ref) v_u_231
		if p_u_230.character:GetAttribute("IsBeingHealed") == true then
			if p_u_230.humanoidRootPart and p_u_230.humanoidRootPart.Parent then
				local v232 = p_u_230.humanoidRootPart.CFrame
				local v233 = v232.Position
				local _, v234, _ = v232:ToOrientation()
				if not v_u_231 then
					v_u_231 = Vector2.new(v233.X, v233.Z)
				end
				local v235 = p_u_230.humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				local v236 = p_u_230.humanoidRootPart
				local v237 = v235.Y
				v236.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, v237, 0)
				p_u_230.humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				p_u_230.humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(v_u_231.X, v233.Y, v_u_231.Y) * CFrame.Angles(0, v234, 0)
			end
			p_u_230:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
			p_u_230.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
			p_u_230.humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		else
			v_u_231 = nil
			if p_u_230.isHealingActive and (p_u_230.humanoid and p_u_230.humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05) then
				p_u_230.isHealingActive = false
				p_u_230:_stopAllAnimations()
			end
		end
	end)
	p_u_230.character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_230
		if not p_u_230.character:IsDescendantOf(game) and p_u_230.healingMovementConnection then
			p_u_230.healingMovementConnection:Disconnect()
		end
	end)
	local function v238() -- name: checkHealingStatus
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_230, (ref) v_u_231
		if p_u_230.character:GetAttribute("IsBeingHealed") == true then
			v_u_231 = nil
			p_u_230:_setWalkSpeedInstant(0)
			p_u_230.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
			p_u_230.humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		else
			v_u_231 = nil
			p_u_230:_stopAnimationByName("getheal")
			if p_u_230.humanoid.Health < 100 and p_u_230.humanoid.Health > 50 then
				p_u_230.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
			end
			p_u_230.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
			p_u_230:_setWalkSpeedSmooth(p_u_230.normalWalkSpeed * p_u_230:_getSpeedBoost())
		end
	end
	p_u_230.character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsBeingHealed"):Connect(v238)
	v238()
end
function v_u_9._bindMiscEvents(p_u_239) -- name: _bindMiscEvents
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_5
	p_u_239.EmoteStateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p240, p241)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_239, (ref) v_u_3
		if p240 then
			p_u_239.resumeSprintAfterEmote = p_u_239.isShiftHeld or p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true
			p_u_239.isEmoting = true
			p_u_239.emoteWalkSpeed = p241 or 10
			if p_u_239.isShiftHeld then
				p_u_239.isShiftHeld = false
				p_u_239:_syncSprint()
				p_u_239.runevent:FireServer(p_u_239.character, false)
				p_u_239:_refreshMobileButtons()
			end
			p_u_239:_setWalkSpeedInstant(p_u_239.emoteWalkSpeed)
			p_u_239.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		else
			local v242 = p_u_239.resumeSprintAfterEmote
			p_u_239.resumeSprintAfterEmote = false
			p_u_239.isEmoting = false
			p_u_239.emoteWalkSpeed = 10
			local v243 = v_u_3:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or (v_u_3:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) or v_u_3:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1))
			if v242 and (p_u_239.humanoid.Health > 50 and (not p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("Aiming") and (not p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("IsCarried") and (not p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("IsHooked") and (p_u_239.player:GetAttribute("runtoggle") or (p_u_239.platform == "Mobile" or v243)))))) then
				p_u_239.isShiftHeld = true
				p_u_239:_syncSprint()
				p_u_239.runevent:FireServer(p_u_239.character, true)
				p_u_239:_refreshMobileButtons()
			end
			p_u_239:_checkConditions()
		end
	end)
	p_u_239.character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsCarried"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_239
		if not p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("IsCarried") then
			if p_u_239.platform == "Mobile" and (p_u_239.isShiftHeld and p_u_239.humanoid.Health > 50) then
				task.defer(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_239
					if not p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("IsCarried") and p_u_239.isShiftHeld then
						p_u_239:_syncSprint()
						p_u_239.runevent:FireServer(p_u_239.character, true)
						p_u_239:_refreshMobileButtons()
						p_u_239:_checkConditions()
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end)
	local v244 = v_u_5:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Mechanics"):FindFirstChild("Slow")
	if v244 then
		v244.Event:Connect(function(p245, p246, p247)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_239
			p_u_239.cantupdatespeed = true
			p_u_239:_setWalkSpeedInstant(p245)
			task.wait(p246)
			if p247 then
				p_u_239:_setWalkSpeedInstant(8)
				task.wait(p247)
			end
			p_u_239.cantupdatespeed = false
			p_u_239:_setWalkSpeedInstant(1)
			p_u_239:_checkConditions()
		end)
	end
	local v248 = v_u_5:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Mechanics"):FindFirstChild("Slowserver")
	if v248 then
		v248.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p249, p250)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_239
			p_u_239.cantupdatespeed = true
			p_u_239:_setWalkSpeedInstant(p249)
			task.wait(p250)
			p_u_239.cantupdatespeed = false
			p_u_239:_setWalkSpeedInstant(1)
			p_u_239:_checkConditions()
		end)
	end
	if p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("snakestep") then
		p_u_239.crouchSpeed = p_u_239.crouchSpeed * p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("snakestep")
	end
	p_u_239.character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("snakestep"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_239
		if p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("snakestep") then
			p_u_239.crouchSpeed = p_u_239.crouchSpeed * p_u_239.character:GetAttribute("snakestep")
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_9._bindPlatformInputs(p251) -- name: _bindPlatformInputs
	if p251.platform == "Mobile" then
		p251:_bindMobileInputs()
		return
	elseif p251.platform == "Console" then
		p251:_bindConsoleInputs()
	else
		p251:_bindKeyboardInputs()
	end
end
function v_u_9._bindKeyboardInputs(p_u_252) -- name: _bindKeyboardInputs
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	v_u_3.InputBegan:Connect(function(p253, p254)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_252
		if not p254 then
			local v255 = p253.KeyCode
			if v255 == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or v255 == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
				if p_u_252.isEmoting then
					p_u_252:_stopEmote()
				end
				if p_u_252.isCtrlHeld then
					if p_u_252.player:GetAttribute("runtoggle") then
						if p_u_252.isShiftHeld or p_u_252.humanoid.Health <= 50 then
							p_u_252.isShiftHeld = false
						else
							p_u_252.isShiftHeld = true
						end
					else
						p_u_252.isShiftHeld = true
					end
					p_u_252:_syncSprint()
					return
				end
				if p_u_252.player:GetAttribute("runtoggle") then
					if p_u_252.isShiftHeld or p_u_252.humanoid.Health <= 50 then
						p_u_252.isShiftHeld = false
						p_u_252.runevent:FireServer(p_u_252.character, false)
					else
						p_u_252.isShiftHeld = true
						p_u_252.runevent:FireServer(p_u_252.character, true)
						p_u_252.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
					end
				else
					p_u_252.isShiftHeld = true
					p_u_252.runevent:FireServer(p_u_252.character, true)
				end
				p_u_252:_syncSprint()
				if not p_u_252:_movementLocked() then
					p_u_252:_checkConditions()
					return
				end
			elseif (v255 == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or v255 == Enum.KeyCode.C) and not (p_u_252:_getActiveAction() or p_u_252.isKnocked) then
				local function v256() -- name: enterCrouch
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_252
					if p_u_252.humanoid.Health <= 50 then
						return
					elseif p_u_252:_isGrounded() then
						p_u_252.isCtrlHeld = true
						if p_u_252.isShiftHeld or p_u_252.character:GetAttribute("Sprinting") then
							p_u_252.resumeSprintAfterCrouch = true
							p_u_252.isShiftHeld = false
							p_u_252:_syncSprint()
							p_u_252.runevent:FireServer(p_u_252.character, false)
						end
						p_u_252.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", true)
						p_u_252.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", true)
						p_u_252.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
						if not p_u_252:_movementLocked() then
							p_u_252:_checkConditions()
						end
					end
				end
				local function v257() -- name: exitCrouch
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_252
					p_u_252.isCtrlHeld = false
					p_u_252.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
					p_u_252.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", false)
					p_u_252.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
					if p_u_252.resumeSprintAfterCrouch and p_u_252.humanoid.Health > 50 then
						p_u_252.resumeSprintAfterCrouch = false
						p_u_252.isShiftHeld = true
						p_u_252:_syncSprint()
						p_u_252.runevent:FireServer(p_u_252.character, true)
					else
						p_u_252.resumeSprintAfterCrouch = false
					end
					if not p_u_252:_movementLocked() then
						p_u_252:_checkConditions()
					end
				end
				if p_u_252.player:GetAttribute("crouchtoggle") then
					if p_u_252.isCtrlHeld then
						v257()
					else
						v256()
					end
				end
				if not p_u_252.isCtrlHeld then
					v256()
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	v_u_3.InputEnded:Connect(function(p258)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_252
		local v259 = p258.KeyCode
		if v259 == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or v259 == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			if not p_u_252.player:GetAttribute("runtoggle") then
				p_u_252.isShiftHeld = false
				p_u_252:_syncSprint()
				if p_u_252.isCtrlHeld then
					return
				end
				p_u_252.runevent:FireServer(p_u_252.character, false)
				if not p_u_252:_movementLocked() then
					p_u_252:_checkConditions()
					return
				end
			end
		elseif (v259 == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or v259 == Enum.KeyCode.C) and not p_u_252.player:GetAttribute("crouchtoggle") then
			p_u_252.isCtrlHeld = false
			p_u_252.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
			p_u_252.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", false)
			p_u_252.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
			if p_u_252.resumeSprintAfterCrouch and p_u_252.humanoid.Health > 50 then
				p_u_252.resumeSprintAfterCrouch = false
				p_u_252.isShiftHeld = true
				p_u_252:_syncSprint()
				p_u_252.runevent:FireServer(p_u_252.character, true)
			else
				p_u_252.resumeSprintAfterCrouch = false
			end
			if not p_u_252:_movementLocked() then
				p_u_252:_checkConditions()
			end
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_9._bindMobileInputs(p_u_260) -- name: _bindMobileInputs
	if not p_u_260.mobileControls then
		p_u_260.mobileControls = p_u_260.player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Survivor-mob"):WaitForChild("Controls")
	end
	p_u_260.actionButton = p_u_260.actionButton or p_u_260.mobileControls:FindFirstChild("action")
	p_u_260.crouchButton = p_u_260.crouchButton or p_u_260.mobileControls:WaitForChild("crouch")
	p_u_260.sprintButton = p_u_260.sprintButton or p_u_260.mobileControls:WaitForChild("sprint")
	p_u_260.sprintButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_260
		if p_u_260.isEmoting then
			p_u_260:_stopEmote()
		end
		if p_u_260.isShiftHeld or p_u_260.humanoid.Health <= 59 then
			p_u_260.isShiftHeld = false
			p_u_260:_syncSprint()
			p_u_260.runevent:FireServer(p_u_260.character, false)
			p_u_260.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
			p_u_260:_checkConditions()
		else
			p_u_260.isShiftHeld = true
			p_u_260.isCtrlHeld = false
			p_u_260:_syncSprint()
			p_u_260.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
			p_u_260.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", false)
			p_u_260.runevent:FireServer(p_u_260.character, true)
			p_u_260.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
			p_u_260:_checkConditions()
		end
		p_u_260:_refreshMobileButtons()
	end)
	p_u_260.crouchButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_260
		if p_u_260.isCtrlHeld or (p_u_260.humanoid.Health <= 59 or (not p_u_260:_isGrounded() or p_u_260:_getActiveAction())) then
			p_u_260.isCtrlHeld = false
			p_u_260.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
			p_u_260.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", false)
			p_u_260:_checkConditions()
			p_u_260.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
		else
			p_u_260.isCtrlHeld = true
			p_u_260.isShiftHeld = false
			p_u_260:_syncSprint()
			p_u_260.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", true)
			p_u_260.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", true)
			p_u_260.runevent:FireServer(p_u_260.character, false)
			p_u_260:_checkConditions()
			p_u_260.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
		end
		p_u_260:_refreshMobileButtons()
	end)
	p_u_260:_refreshMobileButtons()
end
function v_u_9._bindConsoleInputs(p_u_261) -- name: _bindConsoleInputs
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	v_u_3.InputBegan:Connect(function(p262, p263)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_261
		if p263 then
			return
		else
			local v264 = p262.KeyCode
			if v264 == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
				if p_u_261.isEmoting then
					p_u_261:_stopEmote()
				end
				if p_u_261.player:GetAttribute("runtoggle") then
					if p_u_261.isShiftHeld or p_u_261.humanoid.Health <= 50 then
						p_u_261.isShiftHeld = false
						p_u_261.runevent:FireServer(p_u_261.character, false)
					else
						p_u_261.isShiftHeld = true
						p_u_261.isCtrlHeld = false
						p_u_261.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
						p_u_261.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", false)
						p_u_261.runevent:FireServer(p_u_261.character, true)
					end
				else
					p_u_261.isShiftHeld = true
					p_u_261.isCtrlHeld = false
					p_u_261.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
					p_u_261.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", false)
					p_u_261.runevent:FireServer(p_u_261.character, true)
				end
				p_u_261:_syncSprint()
				p_u_261.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
				p_u_261:_checkConditions()
				return
			elseif v264 == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3 and not p_u_261.isKnocked then
				if p_u_261.isCtrlHeld then
					p_u_261.isCtrlHeld = false
					p_u_261.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
					p_u_261.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", false)
				elseif p_u_261:_isGrounded() and (not p_u_261:_getActiveAction() and p_u_261.humanoid.Health > 50) then
					p_u_261.isCtrlHeld = true
					if p_u_261.isShiftHeld then
						p_u_261.isShiftHeld = false
						p_u_261:_syncSprint()
						p_u_261.runevent:FireServer(p_u_261.character, false)
					end
					p_u_261.character:SetAttribute("Crouching", true)
					p_u_261.changeatt:FireServer("Crouchingserver", true)
				end
				p_u_261.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
				p_u_261:_checkConditions()
			elseif v264 == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
				if not p_u_261.canVault or p_u_261.isKnocked then
					return
				end
				p_u_261.canVault = false
				task.delay(p_u_261.debounceTime, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_261
					p_u_261.canVault = true
				end)
				if p_u_261.player.Team == p_u_261.survivors then
					local v265 = p_u_261.character:GetAttribute("Sprinting") or false
					if p_u_261.vaultPoint and not p_u_261.isVaulting then
						p_u_261.isVaulting = true
						p_u_261.vaultEvent:FireServer(p_u_261.vaultPoint, v265)
						return
					end
					if p_u_261.slidePoint and not p_u_261.isSlideingPallet then
						p_u_261.isSlideingPallet = true
						p_u_261.vaultEventPallet:FireServer(p_u_261.slidePoint, v265)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	v_u_3.InputEnded:Connect(function(p266)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_261
		if p266.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 and not p_u_261.player:GetAttribute("runtoggle") then
			p_u_261.isShiftHeld = false
			p_u_261:_syncSprint()
			p_u_261.runevent:FireServer(p_u_261.character, false)
			p_u_261:_checkConditions()
		end
	end)
end
